notes.title: First Gameplay Reveal – Kitchen Sabotage is Here!
notes.content:
🎥 Our First Gameplay Video is Live!
Chefs are hard at work in the kitchen! 🍳 But beware—among you lurk impostors determined to sabotage every dish! 👀

We’re excited to share the very first gameplay footage of Kitchen Sabotage.
Play with 4-12 players online or over local WiFi, cook up delicious meals, and stay alert against sneaky saboteurs!
👉 Watch the video now and witness the chaos in the kitchen!
